blocks.text: National Artist for Music Ryan Cayabyab and the well-loved APO Hiking Society, along with veteran comedienne Mitch Valdes, gather for "naRyan nAPO Kami," the fourth chapter of the MaestroClass concert series, on December 4 to 6 at the Proscenium Theater at Rockwell Center, Makati.
